**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant on Sanofi. Independent searches across the document for solicitation, hiring, recruitment, inducement, and personnel-related restrictions surfaced only unrelated provisions (governance "solicited input", debarment covenants, technical-personnel support, and indemnity party definitions). The preferred position — Customer has no non-solicitation restriction — is satisfied on the face of the document, so no redline is warranted.
